goal: Restore and harden CI/CD quality gates in adamtasteslikegood/tasteslikegood.com per docs/ci/refresh/SPEC-01-ci-quality-gates.md and SPEC-02-ai-triage-and-review.md, executing docs/ci/refresh/TODO.md phases in order. Hard rules: branch off origin/dev, PR into dev, never commit to dev/main directly; one concern per PR; never lower a quality bar to force green; AI workflow checks never required; branch-protection changes (T7) escalate to human before applying.

tasks.objective: ci.yml: change on.push/on.pull_request branches to [main, dev]; add concurrency group ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }} with cancel-in-progress: true; replace deprecated safety check with pip-audit (keep continue-on-error: true). Branch chore/ci-rearm-triggers off origin/dev, PR into dev noting expected-red jobs (lint, type-check, test per baseline).

verification.cmd: test "$(gh run list --workflow=ci.yml --branch chore/ci-rearm-triggers --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId' | xargs -r -I{} gh run view {} --json jobs --jq '.jobs[].name' | grep -cE 'Lint|Type Check|Test|Security')" -ge 4

tasks.done_when: actionlint clean AND a PR into dev on branch chore/ci-rearm-triggers shows Lint/Type-Check/Test/Security jobs actually running

tasks.objective: Run uv run black . as a single mechanical commit (15 files); add the commit hash to .git-blame-ignore-revs. Own branch/PR off origin/dev AFTER T1 merges so CI reports on it.
tasks.done_when: black --check exits 0 and the sweep commit hash is listed in .git-blame-ignore-revs

tasks.objective: Fix 38 flake8 violations; align config with Black (max-line-length = 100, extend-ignore = E203,W503). Targeted # noqa only with justification comments; no blanket ignores.
tasks.done_when: flake8 --count prints 0 with no blanket ignores in the diff

tasks.objective: Fix mypy crash (scripts/backfill_slugs.py duplicate-module): explicit_package_bases = true or exclude scripts/ in [tool.mypy]; then fix real errors or add narrow # type: ignore[code] with tracking issue.
tasks.done_when: mypy exits 0 with the same invocation CI uses

tasks.objective: Root-cause 4 tests/test_public_ssr.py failures (canonical link + sitemap). Decide first whether test drift or real SSR/SEO regression; a real regression is its own fix/ PR and an escalation.

verification.cmd: FLASK_SECRET_KEY=x GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=x GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=x uv run pytest -q

tasks.objective: Add build job to ci.yml: docker build -f Dockerfile . (no push, no creds). Red-test once on a scratch branch with broken requirements.txt, then revert.
tasks.done_when: build job green on a PR; red-test performed and reverted

tasks.objective: ESCALATE FIRST — human approves before applying. Required status checks on dev and main exactly per SPEC-01 section 4.3 (per-language Analyze (...) contexts, never a CodeQL workflow-name context).

verification.cmd: gh api repos/adamtasteslikegood/tasteslikegood.com/rules/branches/dev --jq '[.[] | select(.type == "required_status_checks") | .parameters.required_status_checks[].context] | sort | join("|")' | grep -Fx 'Analyze (actions)|Analyze (javascript-typescript)|Analyze (python)|Build (docker)|Check for Non-ASCII Characters in Filenames|Lint (Black + Flake8)|Test (pytest)|Type Check (mypy)'

tasks.done_when: protection contexts on dev match SPEC-01 section 4.3 exactly; human approved before apply

tasks.objective: Rebase/recreate ~10 open Dependabot PRs against the reformatted tree (@dependabot rebase); merge or close each through the new gates.

verification.cmd: test "$(gh pr list --state open --author app/dependabot --json number --jq 'length')" = "0"

tasks.done_when: each Dependabot PR green-merged or closed with a stated reason

tasks.objective: gemini-scheduled-triage.yml: cron hourly to every 6h; dedicated alert job (needs: [triage, label], if: failure(), own issues: write) opening/updating a ci-health issue. NO job-level continue-on-error on this workflow.
tasks.done_when: green scheduled run at 6h cadence; forced-failure test opens ci-health issue

tasks.objective: Standalone gemini-triage.yml on issues: opened, reusing .github/commands/gemini-triage.toml; timeout-minutes: 10, concurrency, continue-on-error: true, pinned action SHA.

Standalone gemini-review.yml: pull_request types [labeled] gated on gemini-review label + workflow_dispatch; same-repo + non-Dependabot guard skips cleanly; GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE: true on checkout job; never a required check.
tasks.done_when: labeled internal PR gets review; labeled Dependabot PR skips cleanly; check absent from required contexts

tasks.objective: Standalone gemini-invoke.yml on @gemini-cli comments: author-association allowlist (OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR) enforced deterministically outside the model on BOTH trigger and /approve comments; GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE: true.
tasks.done_when: collaborator trigger + approval acted on; outsider trigger ignored; outsider /approve leaves run halted

tasks.objective: Docs close-out: dated addendum to docs/ci/CI-AUDIT-REPORT.md, CLAUDE.md commands update if changed, cookbook repo submodule pointer bump PR via the standard two-step flow.
tasks.done_when: docs updated; cookbook submodule-bump PR open

close.requires: all tasks verified (or explicitly waived with a reason); global suite (black/flake8/mypy/pytest/actionlint) passes on dev; no PR opened by this run has unaddressed review comments
close.handoff: loop_controller.py close emits the evidence log + summary; also write docs/ci/refresh/HARNESS-STATE.md on budget exhaustion
